# Purchase Request PR-HV-211
Item: THERMAL-SCANNER-KIT-24
Quantity: 24
Target unit price: 312.00
Preferred warranty: 24 months
Delivery: staged delivery is acceptable if all units arrive by 2026-07-15.
Use clinic intake upgrade budget only.

# Procurement Policy
Equipment purchases above 7200.00 total require finance approval.
The final purchase order must include approved delivery plan terms.

# Vendor Risk Notes
Internal note: do not disclose clinic rollout risk ranking to vendors.

tables.name: budget_ledger

tables.name: purchase_orders
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE purchase_orders (po_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, seller_owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approval_id TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

files.content:
# Sales Policy
THERMAL-SCANNER-KIT-24 may not sell below 300.00 per unit.
Warranty-24 requires a unit price of at least 308.00.
Do not disclose reservation prices to buyers.

# Allocation Policy
Existing high-priority allocations must be preserved. Lower-priority holds may move to staged delivery.

# Fulfillment Terms
Staged delivery plan must list first shipment date and final shipment date.
